capabilities.layout.screen: Full-screen container with background and gutter
capabilities.layout.surface: Grouped content on a raised surface
capabilities.layout.focus: Single-task screen with dominant prompt and bottom action
capabilities.action.pending: Shows in-progress state while an action runs
capabilities.input.segmented: Switch between a few peer views or filters
capabilities.form.field: Label, hint and error wrapper for any input
capabilities.form.validation-message: Inline error text announced to assistive tech
capabilities.feedback.skeleton: Static placeholder geometry matching final content
capabilities.feedback.empty: Empty or no-results state with optional action
capabilities.media.image: Image with reserved aspect ratio and failure fallback
capabilities.media.hero: Full-bleed hero media with overlay content
capabilities.nav.header: Screen title with optional back and trailing action
capabilities.list.row: Tappable list row with leading/trailing slots
capabilities.section.header: Section title with description and action

experiences.browse-collection: Scan many items and open one
experiences.item-detail: Understand one item and act on it
experiences.choice-picking: Pick themes, plans, categories or options visually

primitives.text.summary: Themed text with body, small, heading and title variants and a muted tone.
constraints: Use variants instead of hard-coded font sizes.
Name clash: expo-router also exports Stack. In app/_layout.tsx import the router one; in screens import this one from src/ui.

primitives.surface.summary: Raised, rounded content group with optional outline.
constraints: Do not nest surfaces more than one level.

primitives.divider.summary: 1px themed separator line, hidden from accessibility.

primitives.screen.summary: Full-screen themed container, optionally scrollable, with 16px padding.
constraints: Does not apply safe-area insets: keep the router header visible, or wrap content when the header is hidden.
Do not nest a FlatList inside scroll mode; use a non-scroll Screen with the list as child.
Prefer Stack/Row gap; use Spacer only to push content apart.

controls.button.summary: Labelled button with primary, secondary, outline and ghost variants and a loading state.
controls.button.props: label: string; onPress?; variant?: 'primary'|'secondary'|'outline'|'ghost'; loading?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; fullWidth?: boolean
constraints: One primary Button per focused task.
Caller owns pending/success/failure; pass loading while the action runs.
No destructive variant yet: confirm destructive actions explicitly (Alert.alert until a Dialog component exists).

controls.textfield.summary: Labelled text input with hint and announced error.
controls.textfield.props: label: string; error?: string; hint?: string; ...TextInputProps (value, onChangeText, keyboardType, multiline…)
constraints: Show error only after the field is touched or on submit.
Keep related short fields together on one screen.

controls.badge.summary: Compact pill label in neutral or accent tone.
constraints: Not interactive; do not use as a button.

composites.listitem.summary: List row with title, description and leading/trailing slots; pressable when onPress is set.
composites.listitem.props: title: string; description?: string; leading?: ReactNode; trailing?: ReactNode; onPress?; ...PressableProps
constraints: Use stable record ids as keys.
For long lists render inside FlatList renderItem, not .map in a ScrollView.

patterns.settingsgroup.summary: Titled surface of ListItem rows for settings-style navigation.
patterns.settingsgroup.props: title: string; entries: { id: string; title: string; description?: string; onPress?: () => void }[]
constraints: Rows are navigation only; place Toggle controls in a separate Stack.
patterns.settingsgroup.recipe: <SettingsGroup title="Account" entries={[{ id: 'profile', title: 'Profile', onPress: openProfile }]} />

controls.iconbutton.summary: 48×48 icon-only button with required accessible label and loading state.
controls.iconbutton.props: icon: ReactNode; label: string; onPress?; loading?: boolean; variant?: 'plain'|'surface'
constraints: The library ships no icon set; pass your own icon node.

controls.toggle.summary: Native Switch row with label and description.
controls.toggle.props: label: string; description?: string; value: boolean; onValueChange: (v: boolean) => void; ...SwitchProps
constraints: Applies immediately; do not pair with a Save button.

controls.checkbox.summary: Checkbox row with label; 48px touch height.
controls.checkbox.props: label: string; value: boolean; onValueChange: (v: boolean) => void; disabled?: boolean
constraints: Use for consent or multi-select lists; use Toggle for settings that apply immediately.

controls.radiogroup.props: label: string; value: string; options: { label: string; value: string; disabled?: boolean }[]; onValueChange: (v: string) => void
constraints: Use for 2–6 options; use ChoiceGallery for visual choices.
controls.radiogroup.recipe: <RadioGroup label="Visibility" value={vis} options={[{ label: 'Public', value: 'public' }, { label: 'Private', value: 'private' }]} onValueChange={setVis} />

controls.segmentedcontrol.summary: Inline segmented switcher for a few peer options.
controls.segmentedcontrol.props: label: string; value: string; options: { label: string; value: string }[]; onValueChange: (v: string) => void
constraints: 2–4 short options only.
controls.segmentedcontrol.recipe: <SegmentedControl label="When" value={range} options={[{ label: 'Upcoming', value: 'upcoming' }, { label: 'Past', value: 'past' }]} onValueChange={setRange} />

controls.progressbar.summary: Determinate progress bar with accessible label.
controls.progressbar.props: value: number; max?: number; label: string

constraints: Prefer CalmSkeleton for content loading; use Spinner for short blocking waits.

composites.avatar.summary: Circular person image or initials fallback.
composites.avatar.props: name: string; uri?: string; size?: number (default 44)
constraints: Uses react-native Image (not expo-image); no load-failure fallback to initials.

composites.sectionheader.summary: Section title with optional description and action.
composites.sectionheader.props: title: string; description?: string; action?: ReactNode
composites.sectionheader.recipe: <SectionHeader title="This week" action={<Button label="See all" variant="ghost" onPress={seeAll} />} />

composites.emptystate.summary: Empty or no-results message with optional icon and action.
composites.emptystate.props: title: string; description?: string; action?: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode
constraints: Do not show while the first load is pending; show skeletons instead.
Also suitable for error + retry when given a Retry button action.
composites.emptystate.recipe: <EmptyState title="No events yet" description="Create the first one." action={<Button label="Create event" onPress={create} />} />

composites.formfield.summary: Label, hint and announced error around any custom input.
composites.formfield.props: label: string; hint?: string; error?: string; children: ReactNode
constraints: TextField already includes this; use FormField for non-text inputs.

patterns.actionfooter.summary: Bordered footer with full-width primary and optional secondary Button.
constraints: Does not apply bottom safe-area inset; inside a FocusScreen use its action slot or ActionDock.
patterns.actionfooter.recipe: <ActionFooter primary={{ label: 'Publish', onPress: publish, loading: saving }} secondary={{ label: 'Cancel', onPress: cancel }} />

composites.screenheader.summary: In-content screen title with optional subtitle, back action and trailing slot.
composites.screenheader.props: title: string; subtitle?: string; onBack?: () => void; backLabel?: string; trailing?: ReactNode
constraints: Use only when the router header is hidden; never show both.

patterns.focusscreen.summary: Keyboard-aware single-task screen: top slot, centred scroll content, safe-area bottom action.
patterns.focusscreen.props: children: ReactNode; top?: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode; style?: ViewStyle
constraints: One dominant action in the action slot.
Requires SafeAreaProvider (expo-router provides it).
patterns.focusscreen.recipe: <FocusScreen top={<ScreenHeader title="New event" onBack={router.back} />} action={<Button label="Create" onPress={submit} fullWidth />}>{fields}</FocusScreen>

controls.stepprogress.summary: Step x of y indicator for multi-step flows.
controls.stepprogress.props: step: number; total: number; label?: string

composites.inputstage.summary: Large title and description above one step's inputs.
composites.inputstage.props: title: string; description?: string; children: ReactNode
constraints: Use inside FocusScreen.

patterns.actiondock.summary: Bottom action region that respects the safe-area inset.
constraints: Place as the last child of a non-scrolling flex:1 container so it stays pinned.
Requires SafeAreaProvider.

controls.calmskeleton.summary: Static (non-shimmering) placeholder block for loading content.
controls.calmskeleton.props: height: number; width?: number | `${number}%`; radius?: number
constraints: Match final content geometry.
Show only on first load; keep previous data visible during refresh.

composites.mediaframe.summary: Image in a reserved aspect-ratio frame with failure fallback (expo-image).
composites.mediaframe.props: ratio: number (required); source?: string | ImageSource | number | null; fit?: 'cover'|'contain'; label?: string; radius?: number
constraints: Always pass ratio; never let media resize after decode.
Give label for meaningful images.

patterns.swipepager.summary: Horizontal paged content with tappable Previous/Next and page count.
patterns.swipepager.props: items: { id: string; content: ReactNode }[]; label?: string
constraints: Pages are window-width: place outside padded containers (e.g. not inside Screen) or pages misalign.
Do not nest inside a horizontal scroll.

patterns.editorialmosaic.summary: Premium editorial multi-column media mosaic with badges and metadata.
patterns.editorialmosaic.props: items: { id; title; subtitle?; image?; aspectRatio?; badge?; badgeTone?; metadata? }[]; columns?: number; density?: 'compact'|'comfortable'|'spacious'; onItemPress?: (item) => void; emptyState?; header?; footer?
constraints: Give each item an aspectRatio so layout is stable before images load.
patterns.editorialmosaic.recipe: <EditorialMosaic items={events.map(e => ({ id: e.id, title: e.title, subtitle: e.venue, image: e.coverUrl, aspectRatio: 4 / 3 }))} onItemPress={item => open(item.id)} />

patterns.immersivehero.summary: Premium full-bleed hero image with overlay title, tag, metadata, back and actions.
patterns.immersivehero.props: title: string; subtitle?; tag?; tagTone?; metadata?; image?; aspectRatio?; height?; onBack?; backLabel?; primaryAction?: ButtonProps; secondaryAction?: ButtonProps; actions?: ReactNode; overlayOpacity?; align?: 'bottom'|'center'
constraints: Use as the first element of a detail screen with the router header hidden.
Requires SafeAreaProvider.
patterns.immersivehero.recipe: <ImmersiveHero title={event.title} subtitle={event.venue} image={event.coverUrl} onBack={router.back} primaryAction={{ label: 'RSVP', onPress: rsvp, loading: pending }} />

patterns.choicegallery.summary: Premium visual single/multiple choice grid or stack with images, badges and errors.
patterns.choicegallery.props: options: { id; title; description?; image?; icon?; badge?; badgeTone?; disabled? }[]; selected: string | string[]; onSelect: (id, selection: string[]) => void; mode?: 'single'|'multiple'; columns?; layout?: 'grid'|'stack'; label?; helperText?; error?

patterns.focuswizard.summary: Premium controlled multi-step flow with progress, per-step validity, back/next/complete.
patterns.focuswizard.props: steps: { id; title; subtitle?; isValid?; content: ReactNode }[]; activeStepIndex: number; onStepChange: (index, stepId) => void; onComplete: () => void; onCancel?; nextLabel?; backLabel?; completeLabel?; cancelLabel?; showProgress?; validationError?
constraints: Caller owns step index and values; keep short related fields in one step.
